purpose: Independent restricted-family dry simplified-Bishop diagnostic of the declared D1 adaptation; no engine changes, no global FoS or dynamic landslide validation

circleFamily.branch: lower semicircle, center at or above both ground endpoints

rejection: arc outside soil or below fixed base
center below endpoint or nonreal lower arc
nonpositive slice weight or driving moment
negativeNormals: Retain formal factor and raw negative-normal counts/minimum normal stress, without clamping, tension crack or physical-admissibility PASS. USACE warns of this limitation.
report: all candidate factors/rejection reasons for both strengths
futureDecision: Interpret only after independent implementation controls and paired MPM review. No automatic strength, geometry, duration, detector or constitutive tuning; any later simulation requires a separately stated rationale.
